negotiation_skill.name: Catalog search and price negotiation
negotiation_skill.description: Single-unit base quotes: lamp 100, chair 180, bookshelf 260 credits. Request a current quote, then offer that total on the same task. No review, referral or extra purchase required.
examples: I want to buy a lamp
I want to buy a chair
I want to buy a bookshelf

claim: Discoverability metadata only; no measured visit lift.
